prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a free mini cleanser offer. Centerpiece is a hand holding a pink Cocoon Hau Giang lotus soothing cleanser 50ml tube against a pale pink gradient background. Surrounding elements: a stacked headline reading 'TẶNG SỮA RỬA MẶT SEN HẬU GIANG 50ML', supporting copy 'LÀM SẠCH, CẤP ẨM & LÀM DỊU CHO DA RẤT NHẠY CẢM', line 'ÁP DỤNG CHO ĐƠN HÀNG TỪ 99K', a bright pink gift circle '74K', and an ELLE BEAUTY AWARDS 2026 winner badge. Keep the exact text hierarchy, award-badge placement, and clean handheld beauty-poster look. Technical style: high fidelity commercial skincare poster with realistic handheld product shot, soft beauty studio lighting, gentle gradient glow and polished clarity, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
